purpose: CMS import manifest for an AI coding agent

import_instructions.upsert_strategy: upsert by external_id; never create duplicates on retry
import_instructions.transaction: import all records in one transaction when supported, otherwise use resumable batches
validation: Use EGP (Egyptian Pound / جنيه مصري) for every priced item; do not infer another currency.
Preserve Arabic UTF-8 text and right-to-left display.
Treat source_value "Applications Prices" as a header, not a price.
Do not discard description_or_option records; they contain menu choices and descriptions.

recommended_cms_fields.menu_item: external_id, section_external_id, slug, name_en, name_ar, description_en, description_ar, price, currency, is_available, source_row_key
recommended_cms_fields.raw_record: external_id, source_row, section_external_id, record_type, name_en, name_ar, price, source_value
